parsed.note_claim: Walmart is not closing its doors.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: In short, Walmart did not announce it planned to close stores and lock their doors on Nov. 1. Walmart spokesperson Joe Pennington told Snopes by phone that the chain will be open for business on that date.
parsed.reason: The fact-check article explicitly states Walmart is not closing stores and confirms they will be open for business, directly substantiating the note's claim.
